==Description==
'''D-60''' is an [[Entities|entity]] made of two purple faces that constantly clash with eachother.

==Behavior==
When '''D-60''' spawns in, it will make increasingly-loud screaming sounds while rushing to the main room.
After '''D-60''' has slammed into the door (or smashed it if in the Depth(Cave) part of the D section), it has a chance to either move to the middle of the room, or wait at the door for a short while before rebounding (skipping the waiting phase).

If '''D-60''' decides to wait in the middle of the room, it's audio will fade out as it makes itself into a black ball. '''D-60''' cannot locker snipe you during this phase, but is still lethal.
After '''D-60''' has waited for 5-7 (2.5 in [[Red Rooms]]) seconds at the middle, there's a 1 in 9 chance (1 in 4 in [[Red Rooms]]) that he will return back to his original state, moving to the door and then moving backwards, speeding up as time goes on.

If '''D-60''' isn't lucky enough, he will instead make a loud wind sound while getting brighter, before fading out completely. This means '''D-60''' has despawned.

==Strategy & Tips==
*When you hear '''D-60'''<nowiki/>'s sound, wait nearby any hiding spot (reccomended a white/blue one because of [[D-55]] comboes) until the static has been on your screen for ~1 second(s).
*After, get into your locker, and wait for it to leave. If '''D-60''' decides to rebound, you can open a few rooms while hes moving backwards. Just repeat this process!
*It may be harder to hear it in the Red Rooms so beware of your screen's static

==Trivia==
*'''D-60''', when sniping; Gives you 20 MAL. DMG, aka Malicious Damage (Malicious Damage takes off of your Maximum Health and can be removed with V-Boosters).
*'''D-60'''<nowiki/>'s locker snipe cannot kill you unless you were under 50 health when it happened.
*'''D-60'''<nowiki/>'s rebound limit is '''7''' rebounds on maximum.
*'''D-60'''<nowiki/>'''<nowiki/>'s''' jumpscare sound is Bonnies Jumpscare from the FNAF Fangame, The Joy of Creation.
*'''D-60'''<nowiki/>'''<nowiki/>’s''' [[D-60i|vari]][[D-60ii|ants]] are entities that both give badges, and are bosses
